rules.statement: A person holding a property is liable to pay rates on it, and if the occupier pays such rates under compulsion, they can recover from the owner.
rules.supporting_quote: "When he speaks of the 'taxes,' he means the 'rate'; and, similarly, the plaintiffs in their plaint, though they talk about the 'rate,' 'the tax,' 'the said rates and taxes,' and 'the said taxes,' mean only the rate; for it does not appear that any 'tax' was ever demanded from or paid by the plaintiffs."
